title: HB2974 (2017 Regular): Relating to exempting certain private firearm transferees from criminal background check requirement.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2017R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/HB2974/Introduced; sha256 afe93799ec4fd648eec81c204576a0b8d69758c63e0ff08bda9be7e958926ea8)
provenance.note: As-filed text (introduced), no votes recorded. Paragraphs (4)(e) and (f) are the additions per the digest. Applies to transfers on or after the effective date.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.435): (2) Except as provided in ORS 166.436 and 166.438 and subsection (4) of this section, a transferor may not transfer a firearm to a transferee unless the transfer is completed through a gun dealer as described in subsection (3) of this section.
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.435): (4)(e) The transfer of a firearm to a transferee who is a certified participant in the Address Confidentiality Program under ORS 192.820 to 192.868.
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.435): (4)(f) The transfer of a firearm to a transferee with a driver license bearing a continuous traveler residence address.
